entities.name: Astor
entities.description: A Keldon warlord, one of the youngest ever, famed for his kukri blades; he fought Skouras, Yawgmoth's Phyrexians and later Sheoldred's invasion.

entities.name: Olvresk
entities.description: A Keldon Doyen who took Astor from Commander Treulk and drove his training.

entities.name: Tajamin
aliases: Keeper of the Book of Keld
entities.description: A Keldon Doyenne who trained Astor with an emphasis on thought; her sacred cudgel triggered an eruption at the Necropolis.

entities.name: Treulk
entities.description: A Keldon commander whose best messenger was young Astor.

entities.name: Kradak
entities.description: Keld's first warlord, who appeared to Astor in a vision on the mountain's peak and warned of the Keldon Twilight.

entities.name: Skouras
entities.description: A blue dragon from across the seas and expert in mind magic who killed the resident dragon and was killed by Astor.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Leader of the Skyshroud elves, taught the ways of Keld by Astor and allied with him through the war against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who planted the Skyshroud Forest in Keld at the start of the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian master who began emerging through the planar portal in the Stronghold's throne room.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: Astor's granddaughter, involved in the Time Spiral crisis, who later rules a united Keldon kingdom.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian leader whose invasion of Dominaria saw the Golden Argosy return.

entities.name: Liin Sivi
entities.description: A warrior who remained at Eladamri's side throughout the campaign.

entities.name: Grizzlegom
entities.description: The new leader of the metathran army met by Astor in Urborg.

entities.name: Nadeen Dormet
entities.description: A stone dwarf rock druid who tunneled into the Urborg volcano and allied with Eladamri.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Hero who fled the Stronghold aboard the Weatherlight and sealed the volcano with a plague ship.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The airship that carried the allied warriors to safety from the Stronghold.

entities.name: Golden Argosy
entities.description: The mythical Keldon longboat that rescued the surviving warriors and later carried Astor for centuries.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: The warrior people of Keld ruled by warlords, who fight the Phyrexians alongside the elves.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invading force that the Keldon undead join in the Keldon Twilight.

entities.name: Keldon Necropolis
entities.description: The Keldon burial site besieged by Phyrexians, where Astor's tomb is later found empty.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The swamp region where the Stronghold stands and the final battle takes place.

entities.name: Letha
entities.description: The village Astor retreated to and used as tinder against Skouras.

entities.name: Skyshroud Forest
entities.description: The forest that Freyalise planted in Keld, home to the Skyshroud elves.

entities.name: Keldon Twilight
entities.description: The prophesied return of Keld's honored dead, who instead sided with the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The Phyrexian overlay of Dominaria that began the Invasion.

events.summary: As a boy Astor serves as a camp runner for Commander Treulk, the best messenger he had.
events.quote: Astor spent much of his early life as a camp runner for Commander Treulk

events.summary: Olvresk takes Astor from Treulk and sends him to train under Tajamin.
events.quote: Olvresk took him from Treulk and sent Astor to train under Doyenne Tajamin

events.summary: Disagreeing with Tajamin's methods, Olvresk storms her compound and his Fists slaughter many of her people; Tajamin saves herself and Astor by invoking the Tinder Spell.
events.quote: He stormed Tajamin's compound and used his Fists, his elite soldiers, to slaughter many of Tajamin's people.

events.summary: Astor learns the Tinder Spell in two days without food, and Tajamin teaches him of Jezal's Covenant.
events.quote: Two days later, Astor knew the spell

events.summary: On the Mountain Astor slays a Colos for food and fights off the wolves it attracts.
events.quote: Astor had found food by slaying a Colos

events.summary: At the peak Astor sees a vision of Kradak, who warns of the coming Keldon Twilight, and Astor becomes a warlord.
events.quote: Astor stood tall at the highest peak of Keld as a warlord

events.summary: At nineteen Astor is granted the far northern lands by Olvresk and sets out to confront a dragon that seems to have broken her oath.
events.quote: Astor had been granted the lands of the far north

events.summary: Astor finds that Skouras killed the resident dragon; Skouras tears through his troops, but Astor hurls the dead dragon's egg into Skouras's hoard as a bomb.
events.quote: Astor used the captured egg of the dead dragon as a bomb and hurled it into Skouras's horde

events.summary: Astor retreats to Letha, blows up the village to ground Skouras, and kills him by channeling the power of Keld into the dragon's mind.
events.quote: This had the rather spectacular effect of exploding the dragon's head.

events.summary: When the Rathi Overlay begins, Freyalise plants the Skyshroud Forest in Keld; Astor meets Eladamri and takes him in, uniting Keldons and Skyshroud elves.
events.quote: Astor accepted the elf and began to teach him the ways of Keld

events.summary: At the battle for the Keldon Necropolis the Keldon Twilight occurs, and the fallen chieftains side with the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Unfortunately, they instead sided with their undead kin, the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Tajamin strikes an undead champion with her cudgel, triggering an eruption and flood; the Golden Argosy saves the survivors and carries them toward Urborg.
events.quote: Tajamin struck one of the undead with her sacred cudgel

events.summary: Astor and Eladamri arrive in Urborg to join the metathran army under Grizzlegom.
events.quote: Astor arrived alongside Eladamri in the swamps to unite with the metathran army.

events.summary: Eladamri allies with the stone dwarves, and the combined force attacks from behind, destroys the Portcullis and raids the Stronghold.
events.quote: defeated the outflanked Phyrexians and destroyed the gate before raiding the Stronghold

events.summary: Yawgmoth begins emerging through the portal in the Stronghold; the allies flee on the Weatherlight and Gerrard plugs the volcano with a plague ship.
events.quote: Yawgmoth began emerging through the planar portal in Stronghold's throne room.

events.summary: Eladamri, Sivi, the Keldons and elves save the Magnigoth Treefolk from the mud-men by burning them into pottery.
events.quote: This plan succeeded in saving the Magnigoths from the mud-men.

events.summary: After the Invasion Astor has a child with a Skyshroud elf, whom he supports from afar.
events.quote: Astor became involved with a female Skyshroud elf

events.summary: Radha searches for Astor's tomb in the Necropolis and finds only his twin kukris.
events.quote: she found no corpse in his tomb, only his twin kukris

events.summary: During Sheoldred's invasion the Golden Argosy returns carrying Astor, restored to his senses after centuries, and he fights his old foes again.
events.quote: the Golden Argosy returned, carrying Astor aboard

relations.note: Astor was Treulk's camp runner as a boy.
relations.quote: Astor spent much of his early life as a camp runner for Commander Treulk

relations.note: Olvresk sent Astor to train under her.
relations.quote: Olvresk took him from Treulk and sent Astor to train under Doyenne Tajamin

relations.note: Astor channeled Keld's power into Skouras's mind, exploding his head.
relations.quote: This had the rather spectacular effect of exploding the dragon's head.

relations.note: Astor accepted Eladamri and taught him Keldon ways.
relations.quote: Astor accepted the elf and began to teach him the ways of Keld

relations.note: She stayed at his side throughout.
relations.quote: plus Liin Sivi, who had remained at Eladamri's side throughout
